create_script_module: create a TorchScript ScriptModule from an nn.Module with method stubs and type sharing
compile_unbound_method: compile an unbound method of a concrete type into a TorchScript method
build_concrete_type: build a ConcreteModuleType from an nn.Module instance with inferred attribute types
